newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable, focus on cargo market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable, focus on cargo market.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were little changed on Thursday with traders' focus on the fuel oil cargo market which was supported recently by a local trader, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $101-$104 and 380-cst at $95/$99. MDO was littled changed at around $200 but gas oil rose to $216/$225 from Wednesday's $214/$222.

As fuel oil stocks remained sufficient in Singapore, many shipowners showed interest but did not go into action, traders said. "They are not sure how the cargo market will move, so if they do buy, they only buy minimum," said one supplier.
